en.t: Of course, sand is not a liquid.

units.source_text: 所以不可能期待它有浮力。

en.t: So there is no way to expect it to have buoyancy.

units.source_text: 软木塞似的东西，即使比沙要轻，但任意放置，也会自然地下沉。

en.t: Something like a cork, even if it is lighter than sand, will naturally sink if it is simply set down anywhere.

units.source_text: 在沙上漂浮的船，必须具有一些不同的性质。

en.t: A boat that floats on sand must have some different kind of property.

units.source_text: 譬如像晃动的大桶形状的房子……

en.t: For example, a house shaped like a huge rocking barrel...

units.source_text: 稍微转动一下，就能把覆盖在身上的沙全部清除，立刻又爬上表面来……

en.t: With just a slight turn, it could clear away all the sand covering its body and immediately climb back up to the surface...

units.source_text: 要是房子整体老是转个不停，那住在里面的人会感到不安定吧……

en.t: But if the whole house kept turning all the time, the people living inside would probably feel unsettled...

units.source_text: 那么，再来动动脑筋，把桶做成两层……

en.t: Then, thinking a little further, make the barrel in two layers...

units.source_text: 内侧的桶，以轴为中心，桶底只要一直朝着重力的方向即可……

en.t: For the inner barrel, it would only be necessary for the bottom, centered on an axle, to keep facing the direction of gravity...

units.source_text: 内侧固定不动，只有外侧转动……

en.t: The inside stays fixed and motionless, while only the outside turns...

units.source_text: 就像大钟上的钟摆，摇晃的房子……

en.t: A swaying house, like the pendulum of a great clock...
